newsitem.title: POLAND: SWARZEDZ PRICES ISSUE AT PLN 8.16-11.
newsitem.headline: SWARZEDZ PRICES ISSUE AT PLN 8.16-11.

text.p: Polish furniture maker Swarzedz SA has set the range of its planned 6.6-million-share issue at 8.16 to 11 zlotys, the firm's spokesman said on Monday.
Sebastian Szczesny told Reuters that the subscription would take place between September 25 and October 16 though specific dates would be provided in August.

The firm is offering 3.1 million shares to creditors in a debt-for-equity swap, 1.75 million shares one-for-two rights, 1.3 million shares in a closed tranche for large investors and 450,000 shares in an open tranche.
Szczesny said that in the closed tranche Polish Development Bank (PBR) would be authorised to take up 350,000 shares and Germany's Schieder Group was seen taking five percent.
